capabilities: Run palette commands automatically when a file or view is opened
Match rules by path, view type, Base view, and frontmatter properties
Pass context variables (path, rule, tags, properties) to QuickAdd choices
Group rules and order them so all matching rules run top to bottom
extras: Not yet in the community plugin browser; installs via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Detailed reference lives in docs/reference.md.
problem: Obsidian can only run commands manually; there is no way to make the vault react automatically to which file or view you open.

relations.evidence: A QuickAdd action receives the context as variables — where you are, which rule fired
Triggers runs commands. Together they do something neither does alone
Markdown, Bases, Canvas, and Excalidraw when that plugin is installed

summary: Rule-based automation plugin that runs palette commands or QuickAdd choices when you open a note, Canvas, Base, or Excalidraw file.
